prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1246; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of the insurer has already been in touch with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide the declarations page for the policy in effect at the time of the accident.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and telematics, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
